Feed
At Hoskin Elevator we grind feed for all species and offer grain bank for those customers who wish to utilize their own corn. We source quality ingredients to ensure your livestock truly reach their full genetic potential. In addition to grinding feed we are proud to be your ADM Feeds dealer. We stock a wide range of ADM products including but not limited to; mineral, tubs, balancers, and complete feeds.
Seed
We work directly with representatives from multiple seed companies to ensure we match the correct seed to your specific application. In addition to corn and soybean seed we also offer a wide variety of cover crop and small seeds. We strive to provide you with the proper blend to maximize your forage.
2027 Davis Seed Product Guide (PDF)
Grain
We are happy to store your grain and offer competitive daily grain markets. It is our goal to get you unloaded in a timely fashion while avoiding long wait times at the dump. Our facilities are continuously being upgraded and 2025 marked a major site upgrade. We expanded our storage capacity by 120 thousand bushel and added a high capacity grain leg and new dryer.
Rock
If your farm or business is in need of rock we can haul it by the semi load on one of our belt trailers. We are able to haul rock ranging in size from granular up to 3 inch.
